finalText:
Builds clean now, 0 errors.

The real problem was two spots left behind by the bump, in `src/core/options.js` and `src/net/retryPolicy.js`.

1. `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That was `undefined`, so calling `.toFixed()` on it crashed the whole build.
2. `isBackoffEnabled` treated a missing flag as an error instead of `false`. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` rather than `false`, so it kept throwing too.

Everything else in the log, the deprecation notices and the smaller warnings, was just noise from the bump, not actual bugs.
